Open, reproducible teaching material in bioinformatics and data science.

I build courses as **web-first, version-controlled infrastructure**: slides,
notes and practicals from one source, published continuously, easy to maintain
and update. This page collects that work and explains the approach behind it.

## Courses

::: {.course-list}
- **Bioinformatics**<br>
  <span class="status">In preparation</span><br>
  Sequence analysis, alignment, databases and hands-on practicals.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
Every course's practicals assume basic command-line competence. The
[Linux Crash Course](https://linux.hoelzer.science) covers it — public and
free-standing rather than tied to one course, so it is worth starting before
you are even enrolled.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Once a course runs, its site is password-protected and the login is distributed
to enrolled students directly.
:::
